name: Simargl
description: Sacred winged dog-dragon and guardian of seeds and sacred fire. Listed among the gods of Vladimir's Kiev pantheon.
mythology: Simargl is a mythical winged dog or dragon-dog creature, possibly borrowed from the Iranian Simurgh (the great Saena bird). He is listed among the idols erected by Vladimir in Kiev (980 AD), confirming his canonical status. He is the guardian of the seed and sprout — protecting sacred grain from destruction and connecting earth and sky as an intermediary. In one cosmological interpretation, the Zorya goddesses chain him to the North Star (Polaris); if his chain ever breaks and he escapes, the world will end. He is depicted as a double-headed dog-griffin or winged lion-dog hybrid.

Sacred Animals: None — is a divine creature himself
